# Fix mouse command invocation bug (2025-06-28 03:14Z)

_**User**_

Fix this bug...

The `ClickQATestPanel` attempts to invoke mouse commands (`left_click`, `right_click`, `middle_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, `mouse_move`) directly. These commands were removed from the Tauri command handler in `src-tauri/src/lib.rs` (to be replaced by the Anthropic Computer Use API via the "computer" tool). Consequently, all related mouse tests will fail at runtime with "command not found" errors.


@Web Fix this to be like the computer use suspect.
